minimumPrerequisite.operationNeeded: The existing owner must admit an anchored scheduled slot and bind its canonical run id and generation in the same transaction; inference completion remains a run_event; only the trusted accepted Turn Review commit binds the canonical review id and changes that slot to reviewed. Preserve deferred, missed, and swept outcomes as distinct slot states.

canonicalRelationship.slotKey: (job_key, slot_at), anchored at the persisted native schedule
canonicalRelationship.runLink: cadence_slot.run_id references toy_si.run(id); the bound run carries the generation and scheduled_slot_at matching that anchored slot
canonicalRelationship.reviewLink: cadence_slot.review_id references toy_si.review(id); only an accepted review commit may set this link and state=reviewed
canonicalRelationship.inferenceCompletion: append the run_event milestone while cadence_slot remains running

smallestPostgresRequirement: Use the canonical owner migration/table for toy_si.cadence_slot, retaining its unique (job_key, slot_at) key.
Enforce run_id -> toy_si.run(id) and review_id -> toy_si.review(id) foreign keys on canonical slot rows.

minimumPrerequisite.liveTrialGate: Do not arm until this relationship is reachable through the canonical owner and its assigned CLI acceptance path, and the R0.01 supported no-spend route/native account admission plus R0.03, R0.05, and R0.06 prerequisites are proven.

currentImplementationEvidence.finding: CapacityTrialJournal exposes only withTest and requires a test environment with a stack id; it operates through a disposable accounting fixture and its trial migration. Its journal API has startArm, deferSlot, reconcileArm, reportArm, and slot, with no canonical run admission or accepted-review operation.

The test migration creates its own toy_si.cadence_slot. run_id and review_id are nullable UUID columns without foreign keys. Its arm-row CHECK requires run_id, review_id, started_at, inference_done_at, and reviewed_at to remain NULL, and excludes running/reviewed states. This fixture cannot represent canonical run/review linkage for a live arm.
The public CapacityTrialJournalApi contains only the fixture journal methods; it has no run or Turn Review relation.
The public package exports CapacityTrialJournal and dispatches caseId=capacity-trial to its registered fixture probe. The inspected public surface contains no Durable admission/Turn Review writer.

publicBoundaryAndCliProof.fixtureRoute: toy probe.run is declared as an R0 test operation mapped to ReplayEnvironment.runRegisteredProbe; case=capacity-trial dispatches to capacityTrialProbe. That probe accepts AT-ops-47, AT-self-improvement-59, AT-self-improvement-60, and AT-RESEARCH-REGISTER-6 only, and records fake_model, liveProviderSends=0, liveTrialStarted=false, wholeATComplete=false. It verifies a test journal, not real accepted reviews.
publicBoundaryAndCliProof.readRoute: review.slots is declared as an R1 read operation mapped to RunControlRead.slots; it is not an arm-start or write operation.
publicBoundaryAndCliProof.gap: The current CLI declarations expose no capacity.trial.start command, and the journal-specific probe does not accept assigned IDs AT-hermes-config-37 or AT-adhd-features-95. The CLI path therefore does not prove a live canonical run/review relationship or the complete assigned acceptance set.

assignedAcceptance.requiredClaim: Separate seven-day arm reports with 3,360 anchored opportunities, settings, accepted reviews, slot outcomes/reasons, latency, allowance freshness, RAM/swap; original and reduced verdicts stay separate.
Same per-arm 3,360 opportunity and measurement report; full-cadence PASS requires each original slot's accepted review before its next-slot boundary, with no reserve violation or paid usage.
All 3,360 original slots require a full scan started in-slot and accepted terminal review before the next slot; swept, deferred, unfinished, missed, missing usage, or paid sends fail full coverage.
Same seven-day arm evidence, with the M2/8 GB host's preliminary 24-hour soak completed before the representative arm.
Same separate original/reduced arm report and accepted-review/coverage evidence.
Same separate seven-day arm report and no-spend/full-cadence verdict evidence.
